title: claim_lost
description: This device tried to claim the issue and another device holds it. Written by callum-flow-claim. Proof that two devices contended for one issue; this device does not work on it.

holder.description: The device that holds the claim; null when it could not be read.

holder_since.description: When the holder claimed it, as its claim comment says; null when not known.

race.description: true: both devices claimed at once and the other won; false: the issue was already held.
